rules.symptom: existing bin reuse after data/mode/version change
rules.trigger_description: manifest mismatch
rules.required_checks: input hashes; mode; arguments; binary/container digest
rules.suggested_action: new run namespace; preserve prior cache
rules.avoid: do not delete cache or trust prefix alone

rules.symptom: segmentation fault around Hi-C input
rules.trigger_description: SIGSEGV or exit139; no root cause assigned
rules.required_checks: scheduler OOM and cgroup limits; stderr; compression magic/integrity; FASTQ pairing
rules.suggested_action: propose next check from collected evidence
rules.avoid: do not equate SIGSEGV with OOM or auto-trim reads
rules.regression_fixture_required: malformed input vs OOM vs real code fault

rules.symptom: memory exceeds allocation during correction
rules.trigger_description: large input and resource failure
rules.required_checks: effective coverage; G range; batches; MaxRSS and scheduler state
rules.suggested_action: separate resource/downsampling experiment if warranted
rules.avoid: do not merge independent bins as equivalent full-data correction
rules.regression_fixture_required: resource failure classified separately from algorithm defect

rules.symptom: ONT input mode mismatch
rules.trigger_description: data metadata not matching selected mode
rules.required_checks: chemistry; basecaller; correction history; FASTQ quality
rules.suggested_action: choose explicit mode in new branch
rules.avoid: do not conflate --ont and --ul

rules.symptom: unrecognized --reason
rules.trigger_description: unsupported engine version
rules.required_checks: actual snakemake --version; environment lock; launcher
rules.suggested_action: compatible pinned environment
rules.avoid: do not remove one flag and assume compatibility

rules.version_scope: issue308 v2.2.1 example; selected2.3.2 launcher mtime
rules.symptom: --paths continuation schedules prior stages
rules.trigger_description: unexpected DAG after timestamp/input change
rules.required_checks: content hashes and mtimes; planned DAG; --assembly provenance
rules.suggested_action: dry-run in separate directory and review intended stages
rules.avoid: no automatic touch or destructive erase
rules.regression_fixture_required: changed timestamp with same hash vs changed contents

rules.version_scope: issue308 v2.2.1 example; general filesystem diagnosis
rules.symptom: Errno122 Disk quota exceeded
rules.trigger_description: quota failure
rules.required_checks: workdir/TMPDIR/actual user cache and log paths; space; inode; quota
rules.suggested_action: report exact limiting filesystem
rules.avoid: no blind cleanup or indefinite retry
rules.regression_fixture_required: quota exhausted with free space still available

rules.symptom: BAM sort alters link and MAPQ handling
rules.trigger_description: header SO not queryname or records disagree
rules.required_checks: BAM @HD plus actual record ordering; expected dictionary
rules.suggested_action: create separate name-sorted input under project policy
rules.avoid: do not claim YaHS rejects all coordinate BAM
rules.regression_fixture_required: header/records mismatch; queryname and coordinate variants

rules.version_scope: issue119 image tag1.2; no verified fix
rules.symptom: unknown --telo-motif
rules.trigger_description: capability absent from actual binary help
rules.required_checks: PATH; actual version; help; container digest
rules.suggested_action: choose tested binary with required feature
rules.avoid: do not infer features solely from image tag
rules.regression_fixture_required: same version label with different capability probes

rules.version_scope: juicer post1.2.1 affected;1.2.2 fixes; <=1.2 unaffected by this bug
rules.symptom: manual curation recovery affected by known release bug
rules.trigger_description: actual juicer post build identified as1.2.1
rules.required_checks: component version; release notes; raw FASTA/liftover/review identity
rules.suggested_action: rebuild result in separate folder with fixed release and validate
rules.avoid: do not assert all scaffolding wrong
rules.regression_fixture_required: known version block and fixed version output contract

rules.version_scope: issue120 version unresolved; only one user workaround
rules.symptom: QV drops after scaffolding
rules.trigger_description: before/after QV disparity
rules.required_checks: same k/database; successful exits; nonN content; AGP consistency; line wrapping sensitivity
rules.suggested_action: reformat copy only and compare sequence-normalized hashes before reevaluation
rules.avoid: do not auto-polish or claim general multiline FASTA bug
rules.regression_fixture_required: wrapped/unwrapped identical sequence with same estimator

rules.symptom: coordinate-sorted BAM input
rules.trigger_description: BAM violates name-order requirement
rules.required_checks: header and actual name ordering; input identity
rules.suggested_action: name-sort into new output with explicit resource budget
rules.avoid: do not reuse YaHS permissiveness
rules.regression_fixture_required: reject coordinate BAM while keep original unchanged

rules.symptom: corrected/raw FASTA or corrected_ctgs mismatch
rules.trigger_description: input combination inconsistent
rules.required_checks: original/corrected hashes; corrected list; AGP coordinate dictionary
rules.suggested_action: supply exact matched stage outputs
rules.avoid: do not replace raw assembly with corrected file silently

rules.version_scope: issue174 version unspecified; current README FAQ
rules.symptom: poor anchoring or chimeric large group after filter relaxation
rules.trigger_description: cluster count/support conflict; high anchoring alone insufficient
rules.required_checks: ploidy; nchrs basis; unique pairs; map; per-join support
rules.suggested_action: small parameter comparison and quick_view review
rules.avoid: do not auto-MAPQ0 or force cluster count
rules.regression_fixture_required: higher anchoring but contradicted joins must not pass

rules.version_scope: historical87 and later local1.0.7 README; commit-specific naming
rules.symptom: refsort expected to fix internal scaffold structure
rules.trigger_description: wrong expectation or ID propagation loss
rules.required_checks: refsort log; source commit; naming map; AGP
rules.suggested_action: preserve mapping; review internal conflicts separately
rules.avoid: do not interpret reference order as independent proof
rules.regression_fixture_required: whole-scaffold order vs internal order; naming changes

rules.symptom: large sequence loss or nearly no purging
rules.trigger_description: size/copy changes; BUSCO stable not sufficient
rules.required_checks: coverage histogram; ploidy/product; ID colons; kmer retained/lost; removed sequence
rules.suggested_action: new cutoff branch with evidence and reversible outputs
rules.avoid: no universal cutoffs; no BUSCO-only safe verdict
rules.regression_fixture_required: repeat loss with stable BUSCO flagged for review

rules.symptom: get_seqs internal deletion when -e absent
rules.trigger_description: explicit extraction policy absent
rules.required_checks: argv; BED; original/retained/removed identities
rules.suggested_action: explicit extraction flags and preserve removed sequences
rules.avoid: end-only is not biological safety guarantee
rules.regression_fixture_required: reuse prior extraction tests; add stage provenance case

rules.symptom: engine succeeds but required QC/final outputs missing
rules.trigger_description: ignored QC failure or optional required artifact absent
rules.required_checks: task exit/log; output parse; AGP/FASTA consistency; required QC reports
rules.suggested_action: mark failed or pending and rerun only justified stage
rules.avoid: do not pass project from Nextflow exit alone
rules.regression_fixture_required: ignored QV and optional absent FASTA block acceptance

rules.symptom: Hi-C输入或参考资源不一致
rules.trigger_description: Hi-C输入或参考资源不一致
rules.required_checks: FASTA、BWA索引、chrom.sizes、酶切位点文件的身份/命名/长度；文库实际酶或Omni-C模式
rules.suggested_action: 重建与目标组装匹配的资源并使用新运行目录
rules.avoid: 不得套用其他组装的索引或将无酶文库猜成特定酶

rules.symptom: early结束后没有hic或恢复阶段读取旧aligned
rules.trigger_description: early结束后没有hic或恢复阶段读取旧aligned
rules.required_checks: 完整命令、-S阶段、现有aligned内容和旧输入身份、退出状态
rules.suggested_action: 按选定阶段的真实目标检查；需要hic时执行相应后续阶段
rules.avoid: 不得把early成功等同全流程完成；不直接覆盖旧目录

rules.version_scope: issue350 report; binary version must be collected
rules.symptom: pre先报列数或格式错误，后报MAPQ通用提示
rules.trigger_description: pre先报列数或格式错误，后报MAPQ通用提示
rules.required_checks: 首个异常、JAR版本、输入解压后列结构和排序、与命令匹配的格式
rules.suggested_action: 先检查输入格式和解压路径，再判断过滤参数
rules.avoid: 不得只见MAPQ提示就改阈值；不得把用户报告当确认根因

rules.symptom: 同一命令要求plot/download与analysis，未生成预期分析
rules.trigger_description: 同一命令要求plot/download与analysis，未生成预期分析
rules.required_checks: 实际argv、日志及主入口action顺序
rules.suggested_action: 将绘图、数据库下载、分析分成独立命令；校验各自输出
rules.avoid: 不得把退出0视为完成全部请求或强制覆盖已有分析

rules.symptom: 数据库版本不兼容或跨run分数不宜比较
rules.trigger_description: 数据库版本不兼容或跨run分数不宜比较
rules.required_checks: 软件、lineage、创建日期、校验和、后端、模式、日志；离线缓存是否完整
rules.suggested_action: 锁定兼容版本，匹配配置重评比较组；404时核对官方可用数据集
rules.avoid: 不得静默更新lineage或直接比较不匹配数据库百分数

rules.symptom: 命中分类或marker长度筛选令人疑惑
rules.trigger_description: 命中分类或marker长度筛选令人疑惑
rules.required_checks: 单marker tlen/HMM命中长度、阈值库、版本和最小复现；确认分支
rules.suggested_action: 保留完整表与命中证据；用固定输入核查长度规则后再归因
rules.avoid: 不得把issue855或注释与代码差异直接当已确认bug；不自动patch

rules.symptom: 误将asm-coverage当所有阶段总数据下采样或参数组合失败
rules.trigger_description: 误将asm-coverage当所有阶段总数据下采样或参数组合失败
rules.required_checks: --genome-size、--meta、--asm-coverage、原始与各阶段数据范围
rules.suggested_action: 按2.9.6手册解释初始disjointig阶段覆盖限制；只在适用组合使用
rules.avoid: 不得把初始阶段降量当全流程抛弃数据或照搬HiFi50X规则到ONT

rules.symptom: 混用输入模式或把keep-haplotypes输出视为完整分相
rules.trigger_description: 混用输入模式或把keep-haplotypes输出视为完整分相
rules.required_checks: 输入测序类型/错误模型、互斥参数、倍性、输出角色和相位独立证据
rules.suggested_action: 单次选兼容输入模式；混合数据交给明确支持的接口；独立评估相位
rules.avoid: 不得将raw/HQ/HiFi无差别拼接；保留变异不等于完整相位

rules.version_scope: reproduced 4.0.0 h6dccd9a_3; 4.3.0 selected validator reviewed, exit-code mapping not tested
rules.symptom: --isolate with --careful
rules.trigger_description: --isolate with --careful
rules.required_checks: exact binary/build; argv; log; old outputs; input hashes
rules.suggested_action: Explain mutually exclusive modes and request a justified mode choice; do not silently switch biological mode
rules.avoid: do not generalize exit255 to all versions; do not overwrite outputs or silently change modes

rules.version_scope: reproduced 4.0.0 h6dccd9a_3; 4.3.0 selected validator reviewed, exit-code mapping not tested
rules.symptom: --continue with extra thread argument
rules.trigger_description: --continue with extra thread argument
rules.required_checks: exact binary/build; argv; log; old outputs; input hashes
rules.suggested_action: Use unchanged continuation or inspect version-specific restart-from constraints; preserve prior outputs
rules.avoid: do not generalize exit255 to all versions; do not overwrite outputs or silently change modes

rules.version_scope: reproduced 4.0.0 h6dccd9a_3; 4.3.0 selected validator reviewed, exit-code mapping not tested
rules.symptom: non-ASCII output path
rules.trigger_description: non-ASCII output path
rules.required_checks: exact binary/build; argv; log; old outputs; input hashes
rules.suggested_action: Stage inputs and execution in an ASCII path, preserve provenance and verify copied results
rules.avoid: do not generalize exit255 to all versions; do not overwrite outputs or silently change modes
